summary: This function works out a fixed charge for a customer based on their tariff type, load in kW, and energy use, and returns that amount.

rules.text: For tariff A2, the fixed charge is 400 for each unit of load in kW.
For tariff A1, if energy used is below 75, the fixed charge is the shortfall of energy from 75, so a lower usage gives a larger charge.
For tariff A1, if energy used is 75 or more, the fixed charge is zero.
For any other tariff, no fixed charge applies and the amount stays at zero.
When the debug switch is set to 1, the calculated fixed charge is printed to the output log before it is returned.
